sectionsContent.title: Vectors Quiz, Version B

concept.summary: Write directly on this quiz. Sketch each vector problem, show your setup, and box your final answers with units.
keyIdeas: A direction has more than one correct name. Any correct form earns credit.
Calculation answers use two significant figures.

equations.note: components of vector A at its angle
equations.plain: Ax = A cos(angle)     Ay = A sin(angle)
Rx = Ax + Bx + Cx     Ry = Ay + By + Cy

equations.note: reference angle, then fix the quadrant from your sketch

sectionsContent.directions: Angles on the 0–360° scale are measured counterclockwise from east: east is 0°, north is 90°, west is 180°, south is 270°. Compass directions such as 35° north of east are measured from the axis named last. +x is east and +y is north.

questions.prompt: The direction 310° (0–360° scale, counterclockwise from east). Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: 310° is between 270° and 360°: below east 360° − 310° = 50° 310° − 360° = −50° same direction:  −50°  =  40° east of south  =  50° south of east

row: same direction:  −50°  =  40° east of south  =  50° south of east

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: The direction 25° south of west. Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: south of west is down and to the left: 180° + 25° = 205° 205° − 360° = −155° same direction:  205°  =  −155°  =  65° west of south

row: south of west is down and to the left: 180° + 25° = 205°

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: The direction −200° (negative means clockwise from east). Write the same direction two other ways.
questions.solution: −200° + 360° = 160° 160° is 20° short of 180°: up and to the left same direction:  160°  =  20° north of west  =  70° west of north

row: 160° is 20° short of 180°: up and to the left
same direction:  160°  =  20° north of west  =  70° west of north

steps.label: Grading (2): 1 point for each correct form

questions.prompt: Rey's speeder moves east at 52 m/s while a crosswind pushes it south at 36 m/s. Find the speeder's resultant velocity: magnitude and direction.
questions.solution: Components, Pythagorean theorem, then inverse tangent with the quadrant fixed from a sketch.

steps.note: that points north of east; the wind pushes south

row: same direction:  −35°  =  35° south of east  =  55° east of south

steps.label: Grading (5): sketch 1 · v setup 1 · v and unit 1 · tan setup 1 · direction 1

questions.prompt: Dumbo flaps at 24 m/s toward 25° north of west while a gust blowing toward 40° east of north adds 9.0 m/s. Find Dumbo's resultant velocity: magnitude and direction.
questions.solution: Convert to 0-360, find components, add, then magnitude and direction.

row: D: 25° north of west = 180° − 25° = 155°     G: 40° east of north = 90° − 40° = 50°
